findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_clean, web_search, seo_check, rss_feed, html_to_markdown, youtube_transcript, github_repo_summary, news_search, hn_search, reddit_search, url_status, sitemap_urls, wikipedia_summary, robots_check, media_convert · Private data: extract_clean, market_spread, gas_fees, best_price, token_price, wallet_balance, web_search, email_validate, dns_whois, pdf_text, seo_check, defi_yields, currency_convert, geo_ip, rss_feed, crypto_ohlcv, ens_resolve, html_to_markdown, youtube_transcript, github_repo_summary, dex_price, tx_status, erc20_balance, news_search, hn_search, reddit_search, defi_tvl, fear_greed, agent_wallet_snapshot, url_status, web_crawl, metadata, sitemap_urls, wikipedia_summary, arxiv_search, npm_package, pypi_package, geocode, domain_rdap, dns_lookup, contract_info, weather, holidays, robots_check, feed_discover, text_stats, timezone, qr_generate, uuid, hash, media_convert, payment_info · Public sink: best_price, email_validate, reddit_search, npm_package · Destructive: media_convert.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "extract_clean" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Structured JSON extraction from any public URL (HTML, PDF, JS-rendered pages). Multi-provider routing with license-aware caching. Pay per call with USDC or USDT on Base via x402 – no API key, no signup. 3 free calls per wallet." → after: "Clean page extraction from any public URL: title, meta description, main text, JSON-LD, language. Optional `schema` keeps only the listed top-level keys. Apify (JS-rendered) with direct-fetch fallback. Pay per call with USDC or USDT on Base via x402 – no API key, no signup. 3 free calls per wallet."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
